name: Track drive sprockets
reuse: Toothed drive wheel with parameterized pitch, hub and rim; preserve track alignment.

name: Light guards and protective cages
reuse: Guard outline, standoffs and mounting feet; keep lamp optics shared.

name: Bumpers and bumper end caps
reuse: Section, end treatment, attachment points and tow cutouts; preserve vehicle width.

name: Gun receivers and breech housings
reuse: Parameterized receiver families, not one universal weapon silhouette.

name: Turret mantlets and gun cradles
reuse: Pivot-relative shrouds and supports; retain weapon sockets and recoil parents.
exclude_pattern: beside the mantlet|either side of the mantlet|left of the cradle|plate welded

name: Cockpit dashboards and instrument consoles
reuse: Console profiles and instrument placements; keep cockpit layouts authored.

name: Engine nacelles and cowling assemblies
reuse: Station loft plus service splits and mounts; aircraft silhouettes remain distinct.

name: Cargo sideboards and tailgates
reuse: Panel runs, posts, hinges and latch placement on authored bed bounds.

name: Turret bustle baskets and open stowage racks
reuse: Open frame paths and mesh panels; closed storage boxes are already shared.

name: Gun shields and weapon-station armour
reuse: Bent plate outlines and viewing slots; keep traverse envelope.

name: Suspension arms and hubs
reuse: Endpoint-based links, joints and spring/damper pairs; solid axles already exist.

name: Fuel fillers and filler caps
reuse: Recess, neck, cap and optional tether; preserve supplied outward axis.

name: Air cleaners, filters and snorkels
reuse: Filter housings, clamps and pipe transitions; not generic turbine ducts.

name: Steering wheels and control columns
reuse: Wheel/yoke profiles, spokes and column joints; author placement per cockpit.

name: Towing pintles and hitches
reuse: Mounting plate, jaws and pin; tow balls and recovery shackles are separate parts.

name: Aircraft pitot and probe fittings
reuse: Tapered tubes, bases and authored angled paths; leave specialized refuelling systems local.

name: Aircraft wheel-bay doors
reuse: Door outlines, inner ribs and hinges on existing Gear/GearUp parents.

name: Missile launch rails and racks
reuse: Rail channels and clamps; ordinary pylons are already shared.

name: External fuel drums and drum cradles
reuse: Drum ribs, ends and cradles; tanker vessel and aerodynamic drop tank are different.

name: Spare-wheel carriers
reuse: Brackets and retention hardware around the shared spare wheel; wheel itself is extracted.

name: Sensor and telescoping masts
reuse: Nested sections, collars and head mounts; optical housings already exist.

name: Radar dishes and radomes
reuse: Separate dish and dome styles with pedestals; retain rotating parents.

name: Aircraft skids
reuse: Bent runner profiles, cross-struts and shoes; wheeled landing gear differs.

name: Slat/cage armour panels
reuse: Bounded rail/slat panels with clearance; reactive blocks remain separate.

name: Vehicle cranes and hoists
reuse: Boom sections, pivot joints and cable routing; vehicle layouts and movement stay local.

name: Helicopter wire cutters
reuse: Blade/support profile and attachment axis.

name: Ship liferafts and life rings
reuse: Canister cradles and buoy attachments; distinct styles, not a single shape.

name: Marine propellers and rudders
reuse: Screw propellers share VehicleMarine.propeller; rudders and waterjets have no shared builder yet.

name: Door/ramp construction
reuse: Finish migrating compatible leaves to VehicleDoors; sliding rails and ramps need extensions.

name: Window and canopy construction
reuse: Extend fitted glazing where compatible; do not enable transparency over solid hulls.

name: Vents and grille construction
reuse: Migrate flat/outline vents; ducts and optimized ship vents may differ.

name: Closed bins and toolboxes
reuse: Migrate top-lid bins; upright cabinets require another opening orientation.

name: Boarding steps and ladders
reuse: Use tread/ladder builders; retain folding stairs and helicopter-specific supports.

name: Handrails and grab handles
reuse: Extend current rails and pulls; preserve optimized marine rail meshes.

name: Seat and bench construction
reuse: Use shared seats; bench and jockey-seat layouts need separate dimension contracts.

name: Exhaust construction
reuse: Extend stack adapters; silencers, turbine grilles and suppressors are not interchangeable.

name: Hose and tow-cable routes
reuse: Use supported cable routes; coils and wound drums need distinct construction.

name: Turret race rings
reuse: Ring cylinder with splash lip and bolt circle; keep the turret pivot.

name: Sight heads and panoramic sights
reuse: Armoured head, bezelled windows and visor; lofted or cylindrical heads stay authored.

name: Commander's cupolas and vision blocks
reuse: Ring, flange and vision-block housings; hatches and weapon rings stay separate.

name: Reactive armour bricks
reuse: One brick per call; grids and face frames stay in family helpers.

name: Rectangular hatch lids
reuse: Flat lids with coaming, hinges and handle; round hatches use VehicleFittings.hatch.

name: Bore evacuators
reuse: Tapered chamber on the gun tube; muzzle sensors and brakes stay authored.

name: Coaxial machine-gun ports
reuse: Port sleeve, barrel and flash hider; the caller keeps the muzzle marker.

name: Automatic cannon
reuse: Breech-to-muzzle sleeve, tube and brake; returns the caller's muzzle.

name: Machine guns
reuse: Receiver-to-muzzle construction with feed and grips; DShK-style finned barrels may stay authored.

name: Rotary barrel clusters
reuse: Barrel ring, clamps and bores along any axis; housings and motors stay authored.

name: Missile launch tubes
reuse: Tube, collars and covers; box launchers with tube mouths are a separate design.

name: Dome and anti-collision lights
reuse: Round lens on a base; box lamps and light bars stay authored.

name: Navigation sidelights
reuse: Red to port, green to starboard on a housing with a visor; screens stay authored.

name: Rotor masts
reuse: Shaft, bearing housing, splines and bolted collars; hubs and blades stay in VehicleRotors.main.

name: Fenders and mudguards
reuse: Flat sheets with bead, bolts and stays; faceted armoured arches stay authored.

name: Saddle fuel tanks
reuse: Round or box tanks on the frame rail; aircraft drop tanks are a different store.

name: Rolled tarps and bedrolls
reuse: Rolled canvas with straps; draped covers use VehicleCloth.load_cover.

name: Track return rollers
reuse: Rubber-tyred rollers on stub axles; registers nothing.

name: Truck cargo beds
reuse: Deck, runners, rails, posts, dropsides and tailgate on authored bounds.

name: Box bodies and shutters
reuse: Body, doors, shutters and ladders from authored bounds and wall faces.

name: Smoke discharger banks
reuse: Bracket, junction box and tubes from the family's own layout.

name: Air-launched missiles
reuse: Revolved body, nose style, slab fins, band and rail.

name: Rotor hub caps
reuse: Faceted or domed caps with flange and absorbers on the rotor pivot.

name: Lamp units
reuse: Housing, inserts, indicator and guard; light bars stay authored.

name: Engine intake faces
reuse: Hub or spinner, blades, vanes or dust cone behind the lip.

name: Pedestal gun mounts
reuse: Plate, post, braces, swivel and yoke around the caller's pivot.

name: Roll cages and bull bars
reuse: Tube members with detected joints, clamps and base plates.

name: Aircraft store pods
pattern: \btargeting pod|\bECM pod|\bjamming pod|\bdrop tank|\bfuel tank under
reuse: Store body with lugs, pads, bands and preset details.

name: Muzzle brakes and muzzle sensors
reuse: Sleeve, baffles and side ports from the barrel's end; sensor box with its bore window.

name: Gun travel locks
reuse: Folding struts, arm and saddle from a foot to the barrel cradle.

name: Trim vanes and bow boards
reuse: Hinged board with ribs and hinges on the hull face.

name: Searchlights and light bars
reuse: Barrel lamp on a yoke or bracket; lens rows in a bar housing.

name: Roof racks and crate loads
reuse: Rails, feet and slats; deterministic stacks of strapped crates.

name: Tanker and supply equipment
reuse: Walkway, manholes and rails along a tank; pump doors and reels; bottles in a rack.

name: Helicopter landing gear
reuse: Drag beam, strut and oleo to the caller's wheel pivot; tailwheel leg, brace and crown.

name: Countermeasure dispensers
reuse: Box with a field of slots on one face.

name: Formation lights and refuelling receptacles
reuse: Strips and doors laid on the skin, open or closed, with lead-in lines.

name: Aircraft bombs
reuse: Body, fins, lugs and a guidance kit by preset.

name: Chin turrets
reuse: Drum, cradle, feed chute and magazines on the caller's turret pivot.

name: Hydraulic rams
reuse: Barrel and rod between two pins with eyes and an optional hose.

name: Plates, crosses and lettering
reuse: Embossed plate in a holder; cross on a ground; the shared stroke font.

name: Door levers and sliding-door rails
reuse: Handle with boss and pin; rail with brackets along a surface.

name: Boat bow eyes
reuse: Ring with a backing plate on the stem.
